description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate from Oracle Database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL with managed identity authentication
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Photo Album application database from Oracle Database XE 21c to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The migration must include: (1) Database schema migration - convert Oracle-specific DDL and data types to PostgreSQL equivalents, including BLOB to BYTEA conversion for photo storage; (2) Convert all Oracle-specific SQL queries in PhotoRepository (including native queries using ROWNUM, TO_CHAR, and analytical functions) to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax; (3) Update JDBC driver from ojdbc8 to PostgreSQL JDBC driver; (4) Configure Spring Boot to use PostgreSQL dialect instead of OracleDialect; (5) Implement managed identity authentication for secure, credential-free database access using Azure SDK; (6) Update application.properties with PostgreSQL connection configuration; (7) Maintain all existing functionality including photo upload, retrieval, deletion, and navigation features; (8) Ensure backward compatibility with existing data structures and API contracts. Authentication method: Managed Identity (Azure-native, secure, credential-free).

tasks.description: Update Docker containerization for Azure Container Apps deployment
tasks.requirements: Update the existing Dockerfile and container configuration to support deployment to Azure Container Apps. Ensure the container image builds correctly with the PostgreSQL-based application, handles environment variable injection for database connection strings and managed identity configuration, and is optimized for the Azure Container Apps runtime.

tasks.description: Deploy the containerized Photo Album application to Azure Container Apps
tasks.requirements: Deploy the containerized Photo Album application to Azure Container Apps using Bicep IaC. The deployment must: (1) Provision an Azure Container Apps environment and container app resource; (2) Provision Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server and configure it for managed identity access; (3) Configure the container app to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using managed identity; (4) Set up appropriate scaling rules, resource limits, and ingress configuration to expose the application on port 8080; (5) Output the application URL after successful deployment.
